decisions.reason: The dismantling joint fits the firm's pipe and valve fittings range, but it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests weaker commitment and leaves it the most exposed if results fall short of aspiration after one year.

The bracket has its own page, so the firm has visibly committed to it, and it complements the core pipe-support business; with results still uncertain after one year, a young manufacturer would carry it rather than start problemistic search.
The pipe support bracket is closely related to the established product line, has its own page, and costs little to keep in an existing range, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
